eligibility_record.evaluation_purpose: Determine whether SREG-2026-0001 may participate as governed evidence independently corroborating the registered identity, source authority, provenance, reviewed subject state, and traceable relationship of SC-CERT-2026-0001.
eligibility_record.scope: Evidence within the Satoshium Registry institutional domain concerning the registration of SC-CERT-2026-0001; source-system identity; source authority; authoritative source-record reference; referenced Certifier package version; Atlas Certification Subject and reviewed subject state; cross-Suite provenance; and Registry-owned relationship information.
basis_references: SREG-2026-0001 — canonical Satoshium Registry Entry, version 1.0
SC-CERT-2026-0001 — canonical Satoshium Certifier Certification Package, version 1.1
Satoshium Attestor Rules — authority, provenance, scope, evidence-context, traceability, bounded-truth, independent-evaluation, uncertainty, and interoperability controls
eligibility_record.relevant_time_or_state: Certifier certification date and reviewed Atlas subject state represented by Registry: 2026-07-05. Referenced Certifier package: version 1.1. Registry object: SREG-2026-0001 version 1.0, registered 2026-08-02, represented as Active and Published. Attestor production evaluation context: 2026-09-19.
limitations: Registry records and catalogs the certification; it does not independently perform or replace Satoshium Certifier's certification.
Satoshium Certifier remains authoritative for the certification decision, class, status, evidence, and Certifier lifecycle.
Satoshium Atlas remains authoritative for the underlying El Salvador jurisdiction intelligence.
Certifier-domain facts preserved by Registry remain attributed source facts and must not be recast as independent Registry determinations.
Registry Validation applies to the Registry-owned object and does not establish Attestor Validation or the correctness of the Certifier certification decision.
The 2026-07-05 reviewed-subject state must not automatically be generalized to subsequent Atlas states.
Eligibility does not establish the eventual Attestor Evaluation Outcome.
exclusions: Independent certification of the Atlas subject by Registry.
Independent confirmation by Registry of the substantive correctness of the Certifier certification decision.
Substantive truth determination concerning the Atlas El Salvador jurisdiction intelligence.
Treating Registry Active or Published state as Certifier certification status or lifecycle state.
Treating Certifier package version 1.1 as the version of SREG-2026-0001.
Historical prototype 100/100 or High assessment material as part of the present Attestor proposition.
Automatic inference of a favorable Attestor Evaluation Outcome.
Any inference that registration transfers authority.
notes: Production Eligibility Record for the first controlled Satoshium Attestor production operation.
Eligibility is separate from Validation and Evaluation Outcome.

The governed input is eligible specifically for Registry-owned identity, registration, provenance, source-attribution, reviewed-state, and relationship evidence while Certifier and Atlas authority remain preserved.
